saga: Y1 Steward Aldous the Steady: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Aldous the Steady: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — the Hanged Grove. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Aldous the Steady: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y2 The war-camp stirs — the Hanged Grove may march soon.
Y2 Steward Aldous the Steady: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y3 The host marches on the Hanged Grove — 14 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y3 The host falls upon the Hanged Grove! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y3 The war-tents of the Hanged Grove burn. The camp itself is stripped — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods. The folk are spared — and they will remember.
Y4 The host returns from the Hanged Grove with the hoard. Justice, not slaughter.
Y4 Steward Aldous the Steady: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y6 A warlord has claimed the Hanged Grove: Warlord Skarde the Grinning. His banner rises over the tents.
Y6 Steward Aldous the Steady: “Warlord Skarde the Grinning has claimed the nest. His raids will march from there — you can watch that road now.”
Y6 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y6 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y6 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.

Y7 The war-camp stirs — the Hanged Grove may march soon.
Y8 The host falls upon the Hanged Grove! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y8 WARLORD SKARDE THE GRINNING FALLS at his own hall!
Y8 WARLORD SKARDE THE GRINNING FALLS at his own hall — a mighty blow!
Y8 The camp is stripped bare — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods.
Y8 One slips through the reeds — Wren, a cook. Remember the name: Wren.
Y8 the Hanged Grove is no more. 8 souls. The Chronicle will keep their names even if you will not.
Y8 51 of your soldiers come home marked by the burning. Nothing frightens them now — and they will never lay down the sword.
Y8 The host returns from the ashes of the Hanged Grove. No songs are sung.
Y8 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y8 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
